text: Assumption: Upon an IsoStdOutOfRangeViolation, execution aborts and calls previously registered abort handlers — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Upon an IsoStdOutOfRangeViolation, execution aborts and calls previously registered abort handlers — is this correct?
norm: upon an isostdoutofrangeviolation execution aborts and calls previously registered abort handlers
assumption: Upon an IsoStdOutOfRangeViolation, execution aborts and calls previously registered abort handlers.
rationale: The function is noexcept, the violation corresponds to std::out_of_range, and the core module provides AddAbortHandler for such system aborts.

original.text: Annahme: Bei einer IsoStdOutOfRangeViolation bricht die Ausführung ab und ruft zuvor registrierte Abort-Handler auf — trifft das zu?

original.rationale: Die Funktion ist noexcept, die Verletzung entspricht std::out_of_range, und das Modul core stellt AddAbortHandler für derartige Systemabbrüche bereit.
